Dancing on the Spot Presents Artist(s) Statement! at Berger

Date and Time:
Nov 7, 2026
Saturday, 7:30 PM - 9:00 PM
Location
Berger (Albert) Park
6205 N. Sheridan Rd. Chicago, IL 60660
Event Fee
$15.00
Age Range
Adult
Categories:
Dance , Night Out in the Parks

Description

An improvisational dance show inspired by art and art making, coming to Berger Park Coach House Theater this November!


Purchase tickets here: https://onthespottheatrecompany.weebly.com/

If you've ever made art, seen art, or been curious about art and artists, this show is for you!

Inspired by a visit to Material Studios and Gallery in Milwaukee, we interviewed some of the artists there. The ensemble of this piece has been writing poetry inspired by those interviews. The show will be improvisational dance done to a soundscape that is a combination of interview answers, found poems made from the interviews, and original poetry!


General Admission: $15
Students and Seniors: $10

Featuring: Kim Gelman, McKenna Mahacek, Joshalynn Gibson, Casey Brayndick and Emma Friend

Directed by Emma Friend, Assistant Directed by Casey Brayndick.

For more info about Material, check out their website: www.materialstudiosandgallery.com/
